# Partial distributions of scikit-plots

`scikit-plots` is one large package that needs a compiler toolchain to build. The directories here publish focused parts of the same `scikitplot` import package as separate, small distributions, in the spirit of `mlflow-skinny`.

| Directory | Distribution | Ships `scikitplot.` | Build |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`skinny/`](skinny/) | `scikit-plots-skinny` | `_cli`, `logging` | pure Python |
| [`rank-bm25/`](rank-bm25/) | `scikit-plots-rank-bm25` | `rank_bm25` | pure Python |
| [`corpus/`](corpus/) | `scikit-plots-corpus` | `corpus` | pure Python |
| [`annoy/`](annoy/) | `scikit-plots-annoy` | `annoy`, `cexternals._annoy` | compiled (C++) |
| [`sphinx-ext/`](sphinx-ext/) | `scikit-plots-sphinx-ext` | `_externals._sphinx_ext` | pure Python |
| [`mcp/`](mcp/) | `scikit-plots-mcp` | `mcp` | pure Python |
| [`cleanprompt/`](cleanprompt/) | `scikit-plots-cleanprompt` | `cleanprompt` | pure Python |
| [`cython/`](cython/) | `scikit-plots-cython` | `cython` | pure Python |
| [`mlflow/`](mlflow/) | `scikit-plots-mlflow` | `mlflow` | pure Python |

## How it works

- **One source tree.** Nothing is copied into `libs/` permanently. Each `setup.py` stages the files its distribution owns at build time and removes them when the build exits.
- **One owner per file.** `scikitplot/_distributions.py` says which distribution owns which path, and no path has two owners, so the distributions install side by side. `scikit-plots-skinny` owns the root `__init__.py`; the others depend on it.
- **Generated metadata.** Every file in a lib directory is generated from `scikitplot/_distributions.py`, `libs/_tools/registry.py` and the root `pyproject.toml`. Version specifiers are inherited from the root, so they cannot drift.

## Commands

Run from the repository root.

```sh
python -m libs._tools list       # distributions and what they own
python -m libs._tools generate   # rewrite the generated files
python -m libs._tools check      # fail if generated files are stale
python -m libs._tools build      # build every sdist and wheel
python -m libs._tools verify     # build, then install and test them
```
